text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
“—Across the finish line!!
This year's most fortunate Umamusume is—”

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—Bubble Gum Fellow-san!!
The one who ran into the ritual grounds in first place in magnificent fashion is—
Bubble Gum Fellow-san!!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa! We've found this year's Lucky Umamusume!
—Man, what an exhilarating run!
—This is a great omen for the new year!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Let's all work together to make this a wonderful year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The first horse girl to cross the goal line in the New Year receives good fortune—after participating in this Shinto ritual, I stroll through the shrine grounds with Bubble Gum Fellow, still soaking in the afterglow of victory.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The bag on that cotton candy is so cute~♪
Ah! The candy craft over there, they have Usapy too!
choice_data_list: Ahaha, there's so much to look at!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, Bubble Gum Fellow-san!
I watched the ritual!
It was... so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Wah, really? I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, so you're this year's Lucky Umamusume, little lady!
—I saw how great you did out there!
—That was one refreshing run to watch~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Thank you very much, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bubble Gum Fellow is surrounded in no time. Just as I was about to LANE and say I'd wait elsewhere so as not to interrupt—

text_block_list.name: Ritual Staff
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! We have an injured person!
Stretcher coming through, please clear the way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clack!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. It's not like the reception is bad, either.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright.
Let's move somewhere more visible.
That's the golden rule when you get separated, right?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, this place is packed too...
I wonder if I'll find a Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "I want to be able to use my burst from behind this year," right? I'm doing a light tuning run tomorrow too, so why don't we run side by side to get a feel for it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, please.
Running with you puts my mind in a positive space.
You're always a huge help that way.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(...*giggle* I get it. Having someone whose back
feels so... reliable...)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Whenever I set my sights on something,
he recognizes that it's "worth the challenge"
and pushes me forward...)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(That's why we can carve our way forward.
So much further than taking it on alone—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“...I've gotta find them soon,
my Trainer.”

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, wasn't someone just being carried away?
—Maybe they got injured? With a crowd like this, it wouldn't be surprising.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
......
...Nah, no way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tap on my smartphone, but it doesn't respond at all.
It seems dropping it has completely broken it.
choice_data_list: (This is trouble. At this rate, I won't be able to meet up with them.)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaann!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I push through the crowd toward the source of the voice.
Standing there was――

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaann!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry for making so much noise! I'm looking for someone...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—It was her. Paying no mind to the surroundings, she was simply calling out to me with all her heart."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaann!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Found you!!
Are you okay!? Are you hurt!?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Really? You're not feeling unwell or anything?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm completely fine. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
What a relief, then...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
! With this crowd of people...
It'll be a pain if we get separated again.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Here—your hand.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Because I don't ever want to lose sight of you again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I firmly grasp her outstretched hand.
And with that, the two of us resumed enjoying our stroll through the food stalls.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Brr, it's cold...
It suddenly got really chilly, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a quiet spot away from the crowd,
I hand over the amazake I bought, and we enjoy it together.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Mmm. Delicious...
choice_data_list: Yeah, it really warms up my chilled body.
Yeah, it really seeps into your chilled body, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right.
And besides—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Somehow, right now, my heart feels warm too.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we head home then, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: It might be a little dark around here.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, stay closer to me.
It's dangerous if something happens.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, walking shoulder to shoulder with Bubble Gum Fellow,
we made our way back to the academy.
